info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Wholesale Trading Quote Management API
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Quote Management API facilitates the creation and management of trading quotes within the wholesale banking sector. This API enables users to input, track, and modify quotes for various trading instruments, allowing for streamlined operations and improved decision-making. Typical consumers include traders, financial analysts, and backend systems that require real-time quote data. The API is designed to enhance productivity and ensure accuracy in trading activities.
